title: Can't log in
answer: To reset your password, tap 'Forgot password' on the login screen and follow the OTP sent to your registered mobile. After 5 failed attempts your account is locked for 30 minutes.

title: Charged twice
answer: Duplicate card charges are usually pending authorisations that drop off within 3 working days. If the second charge is still there after 3 days, raise a dispute from Cards > Transactions.

title: Block a lost card
answer: Block your card instantly from Cards > Manage > Block card. A replacement card is delivered in 5-7 working days free of charge.

title: Fraud or unauthorised transaction
answer: Block your card immediately and report the transaction as fraud. A fraud specialist will contact you within 24 hours. Never share your OTP with anyone.

title: Change email or phone
answer: Update your email or phone number from Profile > Contact details. The change is confirmed with an OTP sent to your old number.

title: Cancel subscription or close account
answer: You can close your account from Profile > Settings > Close account once your balance is zero. Premium subscriptions can be cancelled anytime and stop at the end of the billing month.

title: Download a statement
answer: Download statements for the last 24 months from Accounts > Statements. Choose the date range and format (PDF or CSV).

title: Transfer limits
answer: The default daily transfer limit is 1 lakh rupees for UPI and 10 lakh rupees for NEFT/IMPS. You can change limits from Payments > Limits.

title: Raise a complaint
answer: We're sorry about your experience. Your complaint is being passed to a senior agent who will respond within 2 working days with a reference number.

title: Savings interest rate
answer: Savings accounts earn 3% a year on balances up to 1 lakh rupees and 3.5% above that, credited quarterly.
